    </script>

    <!-- Lógica de Navegación, Filtros y Renderizado Ultrarrápido -->
    <script>
        // Estado Global de la Aplicación
        const STATE = {
            query: '',
            selectedBrand: 'ALL',
            selectedDept: 'ALL',
            stockOnly: false,
            sortBy: 'relevance',
            currentPage: 1,
            pageSize: 48,
            filteredProducts: [],
            totalCount: RAW_DATA.length
        };

        // Elementos DOM
        const dom = {
            searchInput: document.getElementById('globalSearchInput'),
            clearSearchBtn: document.getElementById('clearSearchBtn'),
            searchBtn: document.getElementById('searchBtn'),
            brandGlossaryBar: document.getElementById('brandGlossaryBar'),
            brandSelect: document.getElementById('brandSelect'),
            deptList: document.getElementById('deptList'),
            deptSearchInput: document.getElementById('deptSearchInput'),
            sortSelect: document.getElementById('sortSelect'),
            stockOnlyCheckbox: document.getElementById('stockOnlyCheckbox'),
            productsGrid: document.getElementById('productsGrid'),
            paginationContainer: document.getElementById('paginationContainer'),
            visibleCount: document.getElementById('visibleCount'),
            filteredCount: document.getElementById('filteredCount'),
            filterDesc: document.getElementById('filterDesc'),
            activeFilterTags: document.getElementById('activeFilterTags'),
            totalProductsCount: document.getElementById('totalProductsCount'),
            allDeptsCount: document.getElementById('allDeptsCount'),
            toast: document.getElementById('toast'),
            toastMsg: document.getElementById('toastMsg')
        };

        // Formateador de moneda MXN
        const currencyFormatter = new Intl.NumberFormat('es-MX', {
            style: 'currency',
            currency: 'MXN',
            minimumFractionDigits: 2
        });

        // Inicialización
        function initApp() {
            dom.totalProductsCount.textContent = RAW_DATA.length.toLocaleString('es-MX');
            dom.allDeptsCount.textContent = RAW_DATA.length.toLocaleString('es-MX');

            buildBrandGlossary();
            buildDepartmentsMenu();
            attachEventListeners();
            applyFilters();
        }

        // Construir Glosario y Select de Marcas
        function buildBrandGlossary() {
            const brandCounts = {};
            RAW_DATA.forEach(item => {
                const b = item.m || 'OTRAS';
                brandCounts[b] = (brandCounts[b] || 0) + 1;
            });

            // Marcas populares para las Pills superiores
            const sortedBrands = Object.entries(brandCounts).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
            const topPillBrands = sortedBrands.slice(0, 15);

            topPillBrands.forEach(([brand, count]) => {
                const pill = document.createElement('button');
                pill.className = 'brand-pill';
                pill.dataset.brand = brand;
                pill.innerHTML = `${brand} <span class="count">${count.toLocaleString()}</span>`;
                pill.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    setBrand(brand);
                });
                dom.brandGlossaryBar.appendChild(pill);
            });

            // Llenar el <select> con todas las marcas ordenadas alfabéticamente
            const alphaBrands = Object.entries(brandCounts).sort((a, b) => a[0].localeCompare(b[0]));
            alphaBrands.forEach(([brand, count]) => {
                const opt = document.createElement('option');
                opt.value = brand;
                opt.textContent = `${brand} (${count.toLocaleString()} piezas)`;
                dom.brandSelect.appendChild(opt);
            });
        }

        // Construir Menú de Departamentos
        function buildDepartmentsMenu() {
            const deptCounts = {};
            RAW_DATA.forEach(item => {
                const d = item.d || 'General / Varios';
                deptCounts[d] = (deptCounts[d] || 0) + 1;
            });

            const sortedDepts = Object.entries(deptCounts).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);

            sortedDepts.forEach(([dept, count]) => {
                const li = document.createElement('li');
                li.className = 'dept-item';
                li.innerHTML = `
                    <button class="dept-btn" data-dept="${dept}">
                        <span>${dept}</span>
                        <span class="dept-badge">${count.toLocaleString()}</span>
                    </button>
                `;
                li.querySelector('button').addEventListener('click', () => {
                    setDept(dept);
                });
                dom.deptList.appendChild(li);
            });
        }

        // Manejadores de Eventos
        function attachEventListeners() {
            // Búsqueda con Debounce
            let debounceTimer;
            dom.searchInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
                const val = e.target.value;
                dom.clearSearchBtn.style.display = val ? 'block' : 'none';
                clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
                debounceTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                    STATE.query = val.trim().toLowerCase();
                    STATE.currentPage = 1;
                    applyFilters();
                }, 250);
            });

            dom.clearSearchBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                dom.searchInput.value = '';
                dom.clearSearchBtn.style.display = 'none';
                STATE.query = '';
                STATE.currentPage = 1;
                applyFilters();
                dom.searchInput.focus();
            });

            dom.searchBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                STATE.query = dom.searchInput.value.trim().toLowerCase();
                STATE.currentPage = 1;
                applyFilters();
            });

            // Filtro de Marcas
            dom.brandSelect.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
                setBrand(e.target.value);
            });

            // Botón "Todas las marcas" en la barra de pills
            const allBrandPill = dom.brandGlossaryBar.querySelector('[data-brand="ALL"]');
            if (allBrandPill) {
                allBrandPill.addEventListener('click', () => setBrand('ALL'));
            }

            // Botón "Todos los departamentos"
            const allDeptBtn = dom.deptList.querySelector('[data-dept="ALL"]');
            if (allDeptBtn) {
                allDeptBtn.addEventListener('click', () => setDept('ALL'));
            }

            // Búsqueda en Departamentos (Sidebar)
            dom.deptSearchInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
                const q = e.target.value.toLowerCase().trim();
                const items = dom.deptList.querySelectorAll('.dept-item');
                items.forEach((item, idx) => {
                    if (idx === 0) return; // Conservar botón "Todos"
                    const text = item.textContent.toLowerCase();
                    item.style.display = text.includes(q) ? 'block' : 'none';
                });
            });

            // Ordenamiento
            dom.sortSelect.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
                STATE.sortBy = e.target.value;
                applySorting();
                renderProducts();
            });

            // Solo con Existencia
            dom.stockOnlyCheckbox.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
                STATE.stockOnly = e.target.checked;
                STATE.currentPage = 1;
                applyFilters();
            });
        }

        // Selección de Marca
        function setBrand(brand) {
            STATE.selectedBrand = brand;
            STATE.currentPage = 1;

            // Actualizar estado de las Pills
            dom.brandGlossaryBar.querySelectorAll('.brand-pill').forEach(pill => {
                pill.classList.toggle('active', pill.dataset.brand === brand);
            });

            // Actualizar select
            dom.brandSelect.value = brand;

            applyFilters();
        }

        // Selección de Departamento
        function setDept(dept) {
            STATE.selectedDept = dept;
            STATE.currentPage = 1;

            // Actualizar botones de la sidebar
            dom.deptList.querySelectorAll('.dept-btn').forEach(btn => {
                btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.dept === dept);
            });

            applyFilters();
        }

        // Aplicar Filtros en Memoria (Ultra Rápido)
        function applyFilters() {
            const q = STATE.query;
            const b = STATE.selectedBrand;
            const d = STATE.selectedDept;
            const sOnly = STATE.stockOnly;

            // Filtrado optimizado
            STATE.filteredProducts = RAW_DATA.filter(item => {
                // Filtro Stock
                if (sOnly && item.s <= 0) return false;

                // Filtro Marca
                if (b !== 'ALL' && item.m !== b) return false;

                // Filtro Departamento
                if (d !== 'ALL' && item.d !== d) return false;

                // Búsqueda de texto (Código, Producto o Marca)
                if (q) {
                    const matchCode = item.c && item.c.toLowerCase().includes(q);
                    const matchProd = item.p && item.p.toLowerCase().includes(q);
                    const matchBrand = item.m && item.m.toLowerCase().includes(q);
                    if (!matchCode && !matchProd && !matchBrand) return false;
                }

                return true;
            });

            applySorting();
            renderActiveFilterTags();
            renderProducts();
        }

        // Ordenamiento
        function applySorting() {
            switch (STATE.sortBy) {
                case 'price_asc':
                    STATE.filteredProducts.sort((a, b) => a.pr - b.pr);
                    break;
                case 'price_desc':
                    STATE.filteredProducts.sort((a, b) => b.pr - a.pr);
                    break;
                case 'name_asc':
                    STATE.filteredProducts.sort((a, b) => a.p.localeCompare(b.p));
                    break;
                case 'brand_asc':
                    STATE.filteredProducts.sort((a, b) => a.m.localeCompare(b.m));
                    break;
                default:
                    // Por relevancia: primero los que tienen existencia
                    STATE.filteredProducts.sort((a, b) => (b.s > 0 ? 1 : 0) - (a.s > 0 ? 1 : 0));
                    break;
            }
        }

        // Etiquetas de Filtros Activos
        function renderActiveFilterTags() {
            dom.activeFilterTags.innerHTML = '';

            if (STATE.selectedBrand !== 'ALL') {
                const tag = createTag(`Marca: ${STATE.selectedBrand}`, () => setBrand('ALL'));
                dom.activeFilterTags.appendChild(tag);
            }

            if (STATE.selectedDept !== 'ALL') {
                const tag = createTag(`Depto: ${STATE.selectedDept}`, () => setDept('ALL'));
                dom.activeFilterTags.appendChild(tag);
            }

            if (STATE.stockOnly) {
                const tag = createTag(`Solo en existencia`, () => {
                    dom.stockOnlyCheckbox.checked = false;
                    STATE.stockOnly = false;
                    applyFilters();
                });
                dom.activeFilterTags.appendChild(tag);
            }

            if (STATE.query) {
                const tag = createTag(`Búsqueda: "${STATE.query}"`, () => {
                    dom.searchInput.value = '';
                    dom.clearSearchBtn.style.display = 'none';
                    STATE.query = '';
                    applyFilters();
                });
                dom.activeFilterTags.appendChild(tag);
            }
        }

        function createTag(text, onRemove) {
            const span = document.createElement('span');
            span.className = 'filter-tag';
            span.innerHTML = `${text} <i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i>`;
            span.querySelector('i').addEventListener('click', onRemove);
            return span;
        }

        // Renderizado del Catálogo de Productos
        function renderProducts() {
            const total = STATE.filteredProducts.length;
            dom.filteredCount.textContent = total.toLocaleString('es-MX');

            const start = (STATE.currentPage - 1) * STATE.pageSize;
            const end = Math.min(start + STATE.pageSize, total);
            const pageItems = STATE.filteredProducts.slice(start, end);

            dom.visibleCount.textContent = total > 0 ? `${start + 1} - ${end}` : '0';

            // Si no hay resultados
            if (total === 0) {
                dom.productsGrid.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="empty-state">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-car-burst"></i>
                        <h3>No encontramos refacciones con estos criterios</h3>
                        <p>Intenta cambiar los términos de búsqueda, seleccionar otra marca o limpiar los filtros seleccionados.</p>
                        <button class="btn-reset-filters" onclick="resetAllFilters()">
                            <i class="fa-solid fa-arrows-rotate"></i> Restablecer Filtros
                        </button>
                    </div>
                `;
                dom.paginationContainer.innerHTML = '';
                return;
            }

            // Construir tarjetas
            let html = '';
            pageItems.forEach(item => {
                const hasStock = item.s > 0;
                const stockBadgeClass = hasStock ? 'in-stock' : 'out-stock';
                const stockText = hasStock ? `En Stock (${item.s.toLocaleString()} pzas)` : 'Sobre Pedido';
                const formattedPrice = item.pr > 0 ? currencyFormatter.format(item.pr) : 'Cotizar Precio';
                
                // Mensaje WhatsApp codificado con código de pieza
                const waMessage = encodeURIComponent(
                    `¡Hola Martín Refacciones!
Me interesa cotizar la siguiente pieza:
` +
                    `• Código: ${item.c}
` +
                    `• Producto: ${item.p}
` +
                    `• Marca: ${item.m}
` +
                    `• Precio: ${formattedPrice}
` +
                    `¿Tienen disponibilidad para entrega?`
                );
                const waLink = `https://wa.me/?text=${waMessage}`;

                html += `
                    <div class="product-card">
                        <div>
                            <div class="card-top">
                                <div class="card-code-wrapper">
                                    <span class="card-code">#${escapeHtml(item.c || 'S/C')}</span>
                                    <button class="copy-code-btn" onclick="copyCode('${escapeHtml(item.c || '')}')" title="Copiar código">
                                        <i class="fa-regular fa-copy"></i>
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                                <span class="card-brand-badge">${escapeHtml(item.m)}</span>
                            </div>

                            <div class="card-body" style="margin-top: 10px;">
                                <div class="card-dept">${escapeHtml(item.d)}</div>
                                <h3 class="card-title" title="${escapeHtml(item.p)}">${escapeHtml(item.p)}</h3>
                                <div class="card-stock ${stockBadgeClass}">
                                    <span class="dot"></span>
                                    <span>${stockText}</span>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div class="card-footer">
                            <div class="card-price-row">
                                <span class="price-label">Precio Neto</span>
                                <div class="card-price">
                                    ${formattedPrice}
                                    <small>MXN</small>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <a href="${waLink}" target="_blank" class="btn-wa">
                                <i class="fa-brands fa-whatsapp"></i> Pedir por WhatsApp
                            </a>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
            });

            dom.productsGrid.innerHTML = html;
            renderPagination(total);
        }

        // Renderizar Paginación
        function renderPagination(total) {
            const totalPages = Math.ceil(total / STATE.pageSize);
            if (totalPages <= 1) {
                dom.paginationContainer.innerHTML = '';
                return;
            }

            const current = STATE.currentPage;
            let html = '';

            // Botón Anterior
            html += `<button class="page-btn" onclick="goToPage(${current - 1})" ${current === 1 ? 'disabled' : ''}><i class="fa-solid fa-chevron-left"></i></button>`;

            // Rango inteligente de páginas
            const pagesToShow = [];
            pagesToShow.push(1);

            let startRange = Math.max(2, current - 2);
            let endRange = Math.min(totalPages - 1, current + 2);

            if (startRange > 2) pagesToShow.push('...');
            for (let i = startRange; i <= endRange; i++) {
                pagesToShow.push(i);
            }
            if (endRange < totalPages - 1) pagesToShow.push('...');
            if (totalPages > 1) pagesToShow.push(totalPages);

            pagesToShow.forEach(p => {
                if (p === '...') {
                    html += `<span class="page-info">...</span>`;
                } else {
                    html += `<button class="page-btn ${p === current ? 'active' : ''}" onclick="goToPage(${p})">${p}</button>`;
                }
            });

            // Botón Siguiente
            html += `<button class="page-btn" onclick="goToPage(${current + 1})" ${current === totalPages ? 'disabled' : ''}><i class="fa-solid fa-chevron-right"></i></button>`;

            dom.paginationContainer.innerHTML = html;
        }

        function goToPage(page) {
            const totalPages = Math.ceil(STATE.filteredProducts.length / STATE.pageSize);
            if (page < 1 || page > totalPages) return;
            STATE.currentPage = page;
            renderProducts();
            window.scrollTo({ top: 180, behavior: 'smooth' });
        }

        // Restablecer todos los filtros
        function resetAllFilters() {
            STATE.query = '';
            STATE.selectedBrand = 'ALL';
            STATE.selectedDept = 'ALL';
            STATE.stockOnly = false;
            STATE.sortBy = 'relevance';
            STATE.currentPage = 1;

            dom.searchInput.value = '';
            dom.clearSearchBtn.style.display = 'none';
            dom.stockOnlyCheckbox.checked = false;
            dom.sortSelect.value = 'relevance';
            dom.brandSelect.value = 'ALL';

            dom.brandGlossaryBar.querySelectorAll('.brand-pill').forEach(pill => {
                pill.classList.toggle('active', pill.dataset.brand === 'ALL');
            });
            dom.deptList.querySelectorAll('.dept-btn').forEach(btn => {
                btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.dept === 'ALL');
            });

            applyFilters();
        }

        // Copiar Código al portapapeles
        function copyCode(code) {
            if (!code) return;
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(code).then(() => {
                showToast(`Código ${code} copiado al portapapeles`);
            }).catch(() => {
                showToast(`Código: ${code}`);
            });
        }

        // Mostrar Toast
        let toastTimeout;
        function showToast(msg) {
            dom.toastMsg.textContent = msg;
            dom.toast.classList.add('show');
            clearTimeout(toastTimeout);
            toastTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                dom.toast.classList.remove('show');
            }, 2500);
        }

        // Utilidad de escape HTML
        function escapeHtml(str) {
            if (!str) return '';
            return String(str)
                .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
                .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
                .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
                .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
                .replace(/'/g, '&#039;');
        }

        // Ejecutar al cargar la página
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initApp);
    </script>
</body>
</html>
